request.description: Production pixel-art sprite for a side-view tactical industrial city game. One full body scrap-reclaimer gunslinger facing RIGHT, standing in a stable firing stance, both boots visible on same baseline. Dark navy long split work coat, ivory steel shoulder plate, burnt orange short scarf, compact chunky brass rifle held horizontally at waist aimed right. Closed dark helmet with one pale teal visor slit. Realistic compact proportions, approximately 5 heads tall, 16-bit hand-pixelled aesthetic, strong readable silhouette, crisp dark outline, 3-value clusters, no antialiasing or gradients, restrained navy teal steel ivory copper palette, light from upper left. Large coat and rifle shapes rather than tiny detail. Transparent background. No text, no frame, no floor, no glow, no extra characters. Entire sprite inside canvas with small margin.

request.description: Wide pixel art BACKDROP for a side-view tactical battle on an industrial foundry catwalk in a vertical city at night. Environment only, NO characters, NO UI, no foreground objects. Layered immense steel factories, distant pipes, suspended walkways, one large circular furnace arch on far right, a few small muted amber windows, dark teal atmospheric haze between buildings. Lower quarter is mostly dark empty shadow so a separate foreground floor and characters can be overlaid clearly. Upper half has quiet broad silhouettes with limited detail, no busy high contrast clutter. Sophisticated hand-crafted 16-bit pixel art, hard aligned pixel clusters, no smooth gradients, no antialiasing, no dithering noise. Restrained palette deep ink navy #101820, slate #1a2833, desaturated teal #304a53, very sparse warm copper #a87547, light from upper left. Level side-on camera, flat horizon, no diagonal perspective, no text or signs.
